title: S08T04 - Complete console parity, accessibility, responsive behavior, and command safety
description: Expose project, sprint, review, spec/change, evidence trust, collaboration, extension, health, and global views using shared contracts and command-mediated mutations.
acceptanceCriteria: Every stable console mutation previews and invokes the same guarded command contract as CLI/MCP and renders policy refusals without optimistic state drift.
Desktop and mobile browser tests pass accessibility, keyboard, responsive, overflow, console-error, and nonblank-content checks.
All repository changes are captured in one or more scoped Git checkpoint commits, or closeout records an accepted no-repo-changes reason.
Relevant automated tests, documentation checks, and strict Boreal health checks pass before closeout.
